newsitem.title: GERMANY: DASA chief to meet Waigel on Eurofighter - paper.
newsitem.headline: DASA chief to meet Waigel on Eurofighter - paper.

text.p: The chief executive of Daimler-Benz Aerospace AG will meet German Finance Minister Theo Waigel on Tuesday to discuss financing for the Eurofighter warplane, Focus magazine said on Saturday.
In a summary of its weekend edition, Focus said DASA had plans to help with the financing by making early repayments of state financing for its separate Airbus civilian jet.
Germany has said it wants to buy 180 Eurofighters, but has had to delay placing the order until it can make up a two billion-mark shortfall in the 23 billion-mark cost price of the aircraft.
A spokeswoman for the finance ministry declined direct comment on the Focus report, saying only that Bonn was in constant contact with DASA over the issue.
DASA, the German partner in the four-country Eurofighter project, has threatened to stop work if no official funding is found before the summer parliamentary recess.
